ConnectionStrings._comment: Local-machine default only, not a secret - points at the docker-compose Postgres service (see Rojan.Server/docker-compose.yml). Override with User Secrets (`dotnet user-secrets set ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection ...`) or the ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection environment variable for anything real.

Jwt._comment: Local-machine default only, not a real secret - every token this issues is only ever trusted by this same local instance. Override with User Secrets (`dotnet user-secrets set Jwt:SigningKey ...`) or the Jwt__SigningKey environment variable for anything real; never commit a production signing key.
